fieldValues.title: A working group needs a domain and standing orders
fieldValues.decision_question: When may a working group be chartered?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-11, while unblocking general-lane work that no working group could claim (clerk#46, clerk#47); awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A working group is chartered only when there is a known domain, a problem set and claims to work from, and it is given standing orders.
fieldValues.rationale: A group with no domain has no boundary to its mandate, and a group with no standing orders has no practice to join.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a chartered group's domain or problem set proves too vague to settle what is inside its mandate.
